icons.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand, style-transfer and background-extraction.
Asset type: ONE production transparent PNG CLI identity icon for a software card heading, designed to read cleanly at 24 and 32 CSS pixels. Use the supplied existing official icon/wordmark as the visual identity reference. Create a faithful FLAT adaptation, not a new unrelated logo. Single isolated symbol, square canvas, centered optically, about 82% of canvas width/height with even transparent padding. Crisp solid flat fills, clean contour and small-size legibility. NO gradients, bevels, lighting, shadows, grain, texture, glossy edge, drop shadow, colored outline fringe, fake transparency checkerboard, frame, outer rounded square app tile, label or wordmark. Background MUST be genuinely transparent alpha, including all negative space. Do NOT draw a white/black background. No text except the symbol's intrinsically required letter or terminal glyph. The output is a standalone icon, not a design board.
Preserve the exact original broad rounded upside-down-U / stylized A arch silhouette, including the large transparent arch cutout below. Remove its multicolor gradient; render the ENTIRE mark in one uniform solid Google-like blue #4285F4. No crossbar, no pointed triangle, no black disk, no added strokes. Flat one-color adaptation of this actual current Antigravity shape.

kimiDark: Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. The supplied image is the approved flat Kimi icon for a light background. Make its DARK THEME companion by changing ONLY the dark K letter to solid off-white #F5F6F7. Keep the exact K outline, same scale, position, same blue dot (#1687FF), same dot placement and margins. No outer tile. Background must remain true transparent alpha. All actual K and blue dot fills are fully opaque, with only a very narrow antialiased contour; every other pixel fully transparent, no speckles, no semitransparent haze. No gradient, shading, shadows, grain, texture or frame. One isolated icon, not a presentation.
